text.ms:
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah Lalu Lintas

Jalan (Larangan Pemanduan Kenderaan Barangan) 2019.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 2 Februari 2019.

Larangan

2. (1) Pemanduan mana-mana jenis kenderaan barangan yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (1) Jadual di mana-mana bahagian mana-mana jalan dilarang pada 2, 3, 4, 9

dan 10 Februari 2019 pada masa yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) Jadual.

(2) Walau apa pun larangan dalam subkaedah (1), Menteri boleh

mengecualikan mana-mana jenis kenderaan barangan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1)

Jadual daripada larangan itu tertakluk kepada apa-apa syarat yang ditentukan olehnya.

JADUAL

[Kaedah 2]

(1) (2)

Jenis Kenderaan Barangan Masa Larangan

(a) Lori pembawa, trak tunda ketika tidak

menunda kenderaan motor dan lori

jongket yang berat dengan muatannya

melebihi 7,500 kg, lori pengangkut rendah,

treler tiang, treler pelantar, lori balak,

jentera berat beroda dan traktor

sepanjang masa

(b) Lori yang mengangkut simen, besi, keluli,

batu, pasir, tanah, amang, bijih timah,

arang batu atau bahan binaan atau

bahan galian yang lain

sepanjang masa

(c) Lori kontena yang mengangkut barangan

selain lori kontena yang mengangkut

barangan dari pelabuhan atau lapangan

terbang ke kawasan perindustrian dalam

negeri yang sama dan sebaliknya

dari 12.00 tengah malam hingga

6.00 pagi

(d) Lori kargo yang mengangkut barangan

elektronik atau elektrik atau bahan

industri kimia dari pelabuhan atau

lapangan terbang ke kawasan

perindustrian dalam negeri yang sama dan

sebaliknya

dari 12.00 tengah malam hingga

6.00 pagi

(e) Lori kargo tanpa muatan yang dalam

perjalanan pulang

dari 12.00 tengah malam hingga

6.00 pagi

(f) Kren bergerak dan lori pembancuh simen dari 6.00 petang hingga 6.00 pagi

dalam jarak 25 km dari tapak

pembinaan tertakluk kepada

had masa operasi yang

dibenarkan di jalan tertentu

Dibuat 24 Januari 2019

[KP/BD/PJ/0.109/31 Jld.4(4); PN(PU2)460/XCIX]

LOKE SIEW FOOK

Menteri Pengangkutan

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRAFFIC (PROHIBITION ON DRIVING OF GOODS VEHICLES) RULES 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 88(1)(c) of the

Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister, after consultation with the

Minister charged with the responsibility for works, makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Road Traffic (Prohibition on Driving of

Goods Vehicles) Rules 2019.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 2 February 2019.

Prohibition

2. (1) The driving of any type of goods vehicles specified in column (1) of the

Schedule on any part of any road is prohibited on 2, 3, 4, 9 and 10 February 2019

at the time specified in column (2) of the Schedule.

(2) Notwithstanding the prohibition in subrule (1), the Minister may exempt

any type of goods vehicles specified in column (1) of the Schedule from the prohibition

subject to such conditions as he may determine.

SCHEDULE

[Rule 2]

(1) (2)

Type of Goods Vehicle Time of Prohibition

(a) Carrier lorry, tow truck whilst not towing

motor vehicle and tipper lorry of which its

laden weight exceeding 7,500 kg, low

loader lorry, pole trailer, platform trailer,

timber lorry, wheeled heavy machinery

and tractor

at all times

(b) Lorry transporting cement, iron, steel,

stones, sand, earth, tailing, tin, coal or other

construction materials or mineral

materials

at all times

(c) Container lorry transporting goods other

than container lorry transporting goods

from a port or airport to an industrial area

in the same state and vice versa

from 12.00 a.m. to 6.00 a.m.

(d) Cargo lorry transporting electronic or

electrical goods or chemical industry

material from a port or airport to an

industrial area in the same state and

vice versa

from 12.00 a.m. to 6.00 a.m.

(e) Unladen cargo lorry on the return journey from 12.00 a.m. to 6.00 a.m.

(f) Mobile crane and cement mixer lorry from 6.00 p.m. to 6.00 a.m.

within 25 km from the

construction site subject to the

limit of the operation time

allowed on certain roads

Made 24 January 2019

[KP/BD/PJ/0.109/31 Jld.4(4); PN(PU2)460/XCIX]

LOKE SIEW FOOK

Minister of Transport
